commit.message:
Update values.yaml

Signed-off-by: MH <zanhsieh@gmail.com>

Fix whitespace issue due to empty value

If not using the ingress feature the domain value would be empty. This
resulted in the template producing an ini file with a line like this:

`domain = \n`

This would cause issues when passing the resource through a tool like
kustomize, which would turn the multiline block into an encoded single
line string in order to preserve trailing whitespace, resulting in
kubectl diffs that are very hard to review.

Signed-off-by: Gustaf Lindstedt <gustaf.lindstedt@embark-studios.com>

commit.message:
[grafana] Make grafana server domain default to ingress host

Fixes #1685

At the moment if you enable ingress on the Grafana chart you also
have to remember to specify the hostname again in the grafana.ini
file to make sure redirects work properly. This update defaults the
ini value to the first hostname in the ingress object to save repeating
information

Signed-off-by: Ben Hardill <hardillb@gmail.com>
